why: Intro to the Terminal plan, 'Match many files with wildcards' (passes: backup holds day1.txt and day2.txt only). The first try ran in trail-log without the notes/ folder, and zsh refused the unmatched glob: 'zsh: no matches found: day?.txt' (nothing copied). The learner fixed the path, `cp notes/day?.txt backup/` ran silently, and ls backup lists exactly day1.txt and day2.txt. The error row belongs to the first attempt.

step.title: Copy two notes with one wildcard
step.instructions: Copy day1.txt and day2.txt into backup with one command: cp notes/day?.txt backup/. ? matches one character, so day1-backup.txt stays out. Check with ls backup: it should hold day1.txt and day2.txt only.

checks.label: cp found the notes
checks.pattern: no matches found|No such file or directory
